description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. A. A. Kanthi Subhasingha as a member of the Minuwangoda PS.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Minuwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the composition of an elected local authority.
